verdict.rationale: Granola Chat accepts natural-language requests to query meetings across scopes and to carry out post-meeting actions such as drafting and sending emails or Slack messages and creating calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. MCP adds natural-language querying from external assistants. The evidence does not show natural language operating the product itself (creating or organizing notes, managing folders, changing settings), so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core in-app operations (note, folder and settings management), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Chat's command execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.
